sections.content: Constraints enforce data rules: PRIMARY KEY (unique+not null, one per table), UNIQUE, NOT NULL, DEFAULT, CHECK (value rules), FOREIGN KEY (references another table).
Foreign keys maintain referential integrity — you cannot reference a user that does not exist. ON DELETE CASCADE/SET NULL decides cleanup behavior.
Key points: indexes often auto-created on keys, constraints prevent bad data at the source, and violations raise errors you must handle.
